answer_citation_docket_contract.audience_question_rule: Each docket must bind exactly one audience and one downstream question, and every imported object key must belong to that same audience/question pair.
answer_citation_docket_contract.location_rule: exact_carrier_entry and full_audit_entry must preserve the carrier artifact and locator declared by the imported carrier slot and audit trail.
answer_citation_docket_contract.piece_rule: piece_citation_entries must follow the imported answer-sheet piece order exactly and must reference the matching imported answer capsules for those pieces.
answer_citation_docket_contract.smallest_sufficient_rule: Each docket entry must name the smallest maintained late-stage answer object sufficient for the stated downstream need: one-piece citation uses a capsule, whole-question handoff uses a sheet, emitted-answer identity uses a card, exact shipped location uses a carrier slot, and full leftward audit uses an audit trail.

emitted_answer_entry.when: Need the released audience/question answer object itself, including its shipped sentence identity and default visible-provenance mode.
emitted_answer_entry.why: The answer card is the smallest maintained emitted-answer object.

exact_carrier_entry.when: Need to point at the exact shipped field or reusable clause that carries the emitted answer.
exact_carrier_entry.why: The carrier slot is the smallest maintained exact-location object.

full_audit_entry.when: Need the full leftward reader walk from the exact carrier slot to the narrow terminal owners for every semantic piece.
full_audit_entry.why: The audit trail is the smallest maintained full-audit object.

piece_citation_entries.when: Need the smallest sufficient answer object for the diff_delta_piece of this audience/question answer.
piece_citation_entries.why: A capsule is the minimal maintained one-piece answer bundle.

piece_citation_entries.when: Need the smallest sufficient answer object for the recompute_piece of this audience/question answer.
piece_citation_entries.why: A capsule is the minimal maintained one-piece answer bundle.

piece_citation_entries.when: Need the smallest sufficient answer object for the changed_family_piece of this audience/question answer.
piece_citation_entries.why: A capsule is the minimal maintained one-piece answer bundle.

whole_question_entry.when: Need the whole downstream answer for this audience/question, piece-complete but not yet bound to one emitted sentence.
whole_question_entry.why: The answer sheet is the smallest maintained whole-question handoff.

answer_citation_dockets.why: This docket answers the late-stage citation-selection question for one audience/question pair without widening any imported answer object.
